protectedBoundaries: Known native receiver records eligible transferred fixed private buffers only; borrowed/conflicting flags and caller-shaped explicit per-row columns decline. WeakMap source registration alone does not authorize aliasing: private importer owner must bind source to its spread-created sink chunk, claim one out-of-band lease and admit it once at DB entry.

The real importer retains and releases the lease around its entire private callback. Public/custom callbacks with the default null owner and generic factory-created resolved references retain old mutable fallback behavior. Identity/geometry checks are constant-size, not an assertion that arbitrary generic typed arrays are immutable.

Canonical DB-resolved tables receive a separate identity-bound ownership check. Eligibility is bounded to64 distinct canonical raw-v6 entries/64KiB, one already-selected compact family, complete native lookup map and normal post-persistence path. Early reservation path is excluded.

Every canonical raw read, alias append and final record append retains both native and DB ownership across awaits. Alias bytes are copied within the bounded group, and only a private record-offset overlay is changed; canonical dedup metadata/cache are not promoted or rewritten.

The unchanged actual record sink remains responsible for4GiB run geometry and fallback. A targeted actual-sink differential test now covers that boundary; complete maps are not trusted for generic factory callers.

Active content overlay reads can avoid flushing queued writes under the existing store path; cold read waiting is neither skipped nor relabeled. No parser buffer is recycled at lease release, because existing record caches may legitimately retain it.

DB registration occurs synchronously before the first resolver await and remains active through rollback. Finalizers close admission first. Finish joins admitted work without cancellation; abort/close cancel then join before storage mutation. Empty-owner paths do not add an await.

Purge first claims finalizing, creates its durable marker, then cancels/joins before storage mutation. A failed marker restores ACTIVE without poisoning an admitted append. Already-admitted operations may validate while DB is FINALIZING because finalization owns their join.

Late private failures survive operation settlement and force finish rollback. Operation rollback never self-joins. The resolution rollback descriptor is adopted before a post-resolution cancellation check.
